title: Red panda in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M15 70 Q5 55 12 42 Q18 32 26 38 Q22 48 24 60 Q26 68 20 72 Z" fill="#C84B1E"/>
  <path d="M13 65 Q8 55 13 45 Q17 38 22 43 Q18 50 20 58 Q21 64 17 67 Z" fill="#8A2E0D"/>
  <!-- Tail stripes -->
  <path d="M12 52 Q16 48 22 46" stroke="#E8935A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M11 60 Q15 57 21 56" stroke="#E8935A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="20" fill="#C84B1E"/>
  <!-- Body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="15" ry="13" fill="#8A2E0D"/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="90" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8A2E0D"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="90" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8A2E0D"/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="93" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#3A1608"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="93" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#3A1608"/>

  <!-- Scarf around neck -->
  <path d="M28 56 Q50 62 72 56 L72 63 Q50 69 28 63 Z" fill="#2E9E5B"/>
  <path d="M28 56 Q50 62 72 56 L72 58 Q50 64 28 58 Z" fill="#5BD08A"/>
  <!-- Scarf hanging end -->
  <path d="M64 62 Q68 70 66 78 L59 77 Q61 69 58 62 Z" fill="#2E9E5B"/>
  <path d="M64 62 Q67 69 65 76 L61 75 Q63 68 61 62 Z" fill="#5BD08A"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="23" ry="20" fill="#C84B1E"/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <path d="M29 28 Q24 14 34 20 Z" fill="#C84B1E"/>
  <path d="M71 28 Q76 14 66 20 Z" fill="#C84B1E"/>
  <path d="M31 27 Q27 18 34 22 Z" fill="#8A2E0D"/>
  <path d="M69 27 Q73 18 66 22 Z" fill="#8A2E0D"/>

  <!-- White face markings -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="15" ry="10" fill="#FFF4E0"/>
  <!-- Eyebrow patches -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="36" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#FFF4E0"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="36" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#FFF4E0"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="36" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="36" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="34.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFF4E0"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="34.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFF4E0"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <path d="M47 44 L53 44 L50 48 Z" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M50 48 L50 51" stroke="#2A1A0A" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M46 51 Q50 54 54 51" stroke="#2A1A0A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="45" r="3" fill="#E8935A" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="45" r="3" fill="#E8935A" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- White markings on head top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="27" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#FFF4E0" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
